title: 寻找边边  (Tracking Down Reporter Bianbian)

segments.t: Back in her office, PR director Stella decides to track down the reporter who leaked the news. She calls Lutiao News to find Bianbian, and is startled when Bianbian answers the line himself.
媒体发稿先停下。
给我打到路条网，查那个边边。
找边边啊？
我就是啊。
你就是边边？
你连客服都接，你也是全才啊。
我等您这电话，可等太久了。
有何贵干啊？
你有没有时间？
Stella decides to pause her press release and deal with the reporter directly.
媒体发稿先停下。
Stella changes tactics. She orders her team to "tingxia" or 'stop' the media press release.
给我打到路条网，查那个边边。
She tells them to call Lutiao Network to "cha" or 'look up' the reporter Bianbian.
找边边啊？
The scene cuts to Bianbian answering the phone, confirming they are "zhao" or 'looking for' him.
我就是啊。
He confirms his identity with "shì", meaning 'is'.
你就是边边？
Stella is surprised and uses "jiu", meaning 'exactly'.
你连客服都接，你也是全才啊。
She remarks that he even answers for "kefu", meaning 'customer service'. She calls him a "quancai" or 'all-rounder'.
我等您这电话，可等太久了。
Bianbian reveals he has been waiting for her call for "taijiule" or 'too long'.
有何贵干啊？
He asks "you he guigan" which is a formal way to ask 'what is your business'.
你有没有时间？
Instead of fighting him, Stella asks if he has "shijian" or 'time' to meet. Let us listen to their phone call again.
媒体发稿先停下。
给我打到路条网，查那个边边。
找边边啊？
我就是啊。
你就是边边？
你连客服都接，你也是全才啊。
我等您这电话，可等太久了。
有何贵干啊？
你有没有时间？
Stella and Bianbian are about to meet. You learned how to say "kefu" for "customer service", the word for "look up", and how to ask about someone's business. See you tomorrow!
明天见！
